systems.system: مراكز تكنولوجية متنقلة لاستخراج صحيفة الحالة الجنائية
systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, General Administration of Criminal Evidence; units supplied by the Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation
systems.tiers: 10 mobile centres handed over as a first batch under a protocol reported 2026-01-18, 25 more planned in a second phase, to serve the governorates; the service offered for the first time outside fixed premises

note: Mobile units through which citizens obtain the criminal-record certificate electronically: a certificate service, not a station record of reports or cases.
